raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Northern Trust Asset Servicing | Bengaluru, India Consultant Officer, Transfer Agency – Matrix Project | Sept 2022 – Present • Led PE and institutional client onboarding and transition journeys, coordinating business, operations and technology stakeholders across
global clients.
Gathered and analysed onboarding requirements, translating business needs into functional requirements and actionable user stories. • Mapped current-state and target-state onboarding processes, identifying process gaps, data dependencies and operational impacts. • Defined process and data flows across Transfer Agency, PE workflows, fund flows and supporting technology interfaces. • Managed user stories, UAT planning and execution through Azure DevOps within an Agile delivery framework. • Coordinated with Technology teams to clarify requirements, resolve dependencies and support implementation of onboarding and transformation changes.
Supported UAT, defect triage, issue resolution and operational-readiness activities through implementation and go-live. • Led Model Office Testing, issue logging and operational-readiness dry runs for transformation initiatives. • Optimized fund static data and workflows across Singapore and UK clients, supporting improved operational processes. • Partnered with Technology teams on automation, reconciliation, data interfaces and system integration initiatives. • Delivered operational demos, training and process documentation to global teams, supporting adoption and delivery readiness. Technical Coordinator, Senior Analyst, Analyst – Transfer Agency | October 2014 – August 2022 • Handled TA finance operations, fund accounting reconciliations, settlements for UK/Ireland funds. • Led PE and institutional client onboarding, transitions, and compliance documentation. • Supported TA platform migrations and system integrations. • Performed risk mitigation through reconciliation checks and defect resolution. • Led global transitions, audits, and training programs. • Maintained 99% SLA adherence ensuring strong client service. • Reconciled client money and fund accounts with 100% quality accuracy for 5 years. • Conducted UAT for Multifonds and PSF, validating enhancements and interfaces.
raw_sections.projects:
PROJECTS • TA Transformation – Matrix Program: Led core work streams for the global TA transformation initiative. Designed and tested EED and Cash Utility modules supporting end-to-end fund flows. Managed user stories, UAT planning (TCXV3), and execution through Azure DevOps within an agile delivery model. Directed Model Office Testing, issue triage, and operational-readiness dry runs ensuring seamless go-live.
PSF Stabilization Project: Managed a 4-member team to test and validate the PSF reconciliation engine for automated transaction matching. Achieved a 35% auto-match rate during UAT and successfully transitioned the solution to production.
TLM Reconciliation Upgrade: Executed full-cycle testing and controlled deployment of the upgraded TLM reconciliation platform. Validated data integrity and ensured complete transaction flow continuity during the system transition.
Debtors Management Migration: Delivered end-to-end migration of Debtors Management processes from onshore to India. Built SOPs, trained regional partners, and ensured a risk-free transition with zero service disruption.
